description: This Java source file defines test step implementations for savings account operations in a Fineract-based project, facilitating BDD testing with Cucumber. It includes methods for creating, approving, activating, depositing, and withdrawing from savings accounts of different currencies, and references various API endpoints and models.

classes.name: SavingsAccountStepDef
classes.description: A class defining Cucumber step definitions for managing savings accounts such as creation, approval, activation, deposit, and withdrawal within test scenarios.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountEUR
methods.description: Creates a new EUR savings account for a client with a specified submitted on date.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountUSD
methods.description: Creates a new USD savings account for a client with a specified submitted on date.

methods.name: approveEurSavingsAccount
methods.description: Approves the EUR savings account on a specified approval date.

methods.name: approveUsdSavingsAccount
methods.description: Approves the USD savings account on a specified approval date.

methods.name: activateSavingsAccount
methods.description: Activates the EUR savings account on a specified activation date.

methods.name: activateUsdSavingsAccount
methods.description: Activates the USD savings account on a specified activation date.

methods.name: createEurDeposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount of EUR into the savings account on a given date.

methods.name: createUsdDeposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount of USD into the savings account on a given date.

methods.name: createEurWithdraw
methods.description: Withdraws a specified amount of EUR from the savings account on a given date.

methods.name: createUsdWithdraw
methods.description: Withdraws a specified amount of USD from the savings account on a given date.
